questions.question: Which choice most logically completes the text?
options: the differences that studies attribute to exposure to anthropogenic noise are likely to be more pronounced for birds than they are for arthropods. 10% 选择
the difference found in the study conducted by Matthew A. Wale and colleagues was likely larger than the average difference for studies of shore crabs included in the meta-analysis. 9% 选择

questions.explanation: 错误 更新于 2026/02/01 以前 预览 查看 147 20 P 系统题库 详情 SAT机考 SAT CMP 2024-K11-NA-02 / Module 2 读写 中等 参与数 - 正确率 79% 题目数 27 中位分 91 方差 15 中位用时 - 区分度 0.63 Top高错点 过度推断 原词匹配倾向 题型识别失误 题目 (27) 显示答案 (1) 86% (2) 76% (3) 82% (4) 93% (5) 79% (6) 94% (7) 61% (8) 72% (9) 60% (10) 71% (11) 82% (12) 69% (13) 67% (14) 71% (15) 93% (16) 80% (17) 85% (18) 58% (19) 83% (20) 94% (21) 89% (22) 93% (23) 90% (24) 68% (25) 96% (26) 89% (27) 53% 阅读材料 Prolonged exposure to anthropogenic noise (sounds from human sources like traffic or mining) can affect animals, as Matthew A. Wale and colleagues found in a 2013 study of shore crabs.
